title: Concurrent event syncs are not single-flighted: the same rows are POSTed twice and a fresh device can mint several anonymous accounts
note: trySyncEvents is single-flight: one run (syncRun), one shared follow-up (syncFollowUp), one pre-settle waiter (syncSettleWaiter); ensureAnonSession shares one in-flight promise. Tests in data-deletion (3 overlapping syncs POST each row once; 2 callers sign up once) and boot-path (5 pre-settle syncs, 1 POST). 4 mutations checked.

title: Event sync with more than 500 rows re-sends already-accepted batches when a later batch fails, creating duplicate server rows
note: Rows go out in chunks that carry their ids (including interleaved local-only rows); each chunk is marked synced as soon as its POST succeeds. Test: a 1001-row backlog with chunk 2 refused stores 1001 rows, not 1501. Red on the old loop.

title: A transient failure of the refresh-token call signs the device up as a new anonymous user, orphaning the listener's identity
note: sbAuth returns {ok,status,body}; signup after a failed refresh only when the server calls the token dead (400/401 invalid_grant or refresh_token_not_found); network/429/5xx return null. The review round (3245074b) also recognises a spent or expired token as dead. Tests cover 4 transient and 2 dead shapes, mutation-checked both ways.

title: races-4 fix is incomplete: listener-action writes and first-run detection still run against an unhydrated store and permanently overwrite durable rows
note: Option A: editStored/storedValue queue an edit per key, replayed over the settled store, with an optimistic overlay: stars, show stars, queue add/remove/move, history, rememberEpisode, cp_shard_shows; the review round (826d3b0e) added playlists and Foray thumbs. offerHomeOnboarding waits for settle. Hydration and durable-store property 2 untouched. Tests in boot-path.

title: cp_saved keeps full untrimmed snapshots (publisher description and chapters) and is re-parsed once per rendered row
note: Stars store savableEpisode (hook trimmed to 280; description and chapters kept, bounded at 4000 chars / 100 rows, because the episode page reads a star's description after a reload). Old entries trimmed on the next star; a refused lsSet leaves the star off. Parses memoised on the raw stored string. 3 tests, mutation-checked.

title: Unbounded session caches: showEpisodesCache and state.itemIndex hold full episode descriptions for every show visited
note: showEpisodesCache is an LRU of 10 shows (read moves to the end; expired pages swept on insert). An evicted show's non-pool itemIndex rows are trimmed to storableEpisode shape but keep their ids. The review round (20c4f498) stops an expired page stripping notes before a refetch answers. 4 mutations red.

title: playerBridge leaks a 'forayplayer:ready' listener on every timed-out wait
note: playerBridge's finish() removes the forayplayer:ready listener and clears its timer. Tested with a controlled timer queue; both mutations red.

title: Dead code in the search section: episodeDedupKey and showIndexFetchCount
note: episodeDedupKey and showIndexFetchCount deleted; a source test (comments stripped) pins their absence.

title: showNameLink builds `#/show/<id>` without encodeURIComponent, while the router decodes the segment and the prefetch handler decodes the whole tail
note: showNameLink and its copies (forayCreditHtml, citesHtml, the credit upgrade) go through showRoutePath/showRouteHash (encoded id); bindShowPrefetch uses parseShowRoute(href)?.id. Templates use esc(showRoutePath(id)) to keep app-security's safeUrl census green. Tests incl. a source guard; mutations red.

title: On the Vercel origin the service worker intercepts /api/* and keys its cache without the query string, so a slow or failing API call returns another query's results; those responses also survive Delete my data
note: The fetch listener no longer answers scope-relative api/ requests; activate removes api/ entries from the retained generation caches. Tests: a timed-out second query is not answered with the first query's body; the old search body is gone after activate. The 'manifest paths plus an allowlist only' tightening was not added (data/show-index.tsv depends on current behaviour).

title: The service worker's activate deletes every CacheStorage bucket it does not own, including the app's own 'foray-shows-index-v1' shard cache, on every deploy
note: activate deletes only foray-gen-* caches outside the kept pair plus a named legacy list (foray-v1..v5). Test: foray-shows-index-v1 and someone-else survive; foray-v4 and an aged-out generation are deleted.

title: The service worker strips the Range header when it refetches same-origin media, so the interlude jingle always gets a 200 full body (Safari expects 206)
note: Requests with a Range header or an audio/video destination are left to the browser. One iOS Safari check that the jingle still plays is owed (PR #835 body).

title: idb-tier (and event-log) cache an IDBDatabase handle forever and never reopen after the connection is closed
note: idb-tier exports a shared idbConnection (forgets the handle on close and versionchange, never caches a failed open) and withStore retries once after InvalidStateError; event-log.js imports both. Tests in idb-tier and event-log.

title: listProgress over DurableStore is O(n²): key(i) and length rebuild the owned-key array on every call
note: DurableStore.keys(prefix) is a one-snapshot read; listProgress uses it when available. Test: at most one owned-key rebuild. Capping cp_pos rows by recency is left as the follow-up the brief allows.

title: TtlCache never evicts, and the show-scoped path has no rate limit: unbounded memory growth and outbound feed-fetch amplification
note: TtlCache takes maxEntries (default 500), sweeps expired entries on set and evicts the oldest; new KeyedBuckets (keys capped); each show gets 6 feed fetches per minute per instance, then a degraded answer. api/_test/bounded-caches.test.mjs, mutation-checked. Limits are per warm instance.

title: The CI `api` job installs with `npm install`, but Vercel installs with `npm ci`, so CI can pass on a lockfile/manifest mismatch that breaks the production deploy
note: In PR #821. The api job runs npm ci and npm ci --omit=dev --prefix ../backend with a cache keyed on both lockfiles, matching vercel.json; pinned in ci-workflow.test.mjs.

title: The iOS build paths (including the TestFlight release action) still use `npm install` under a stale 'no committed lockfile' comment, while Android uses `npm ci`
note: In PR #821. ios-build.yml and the ios-archive composite run npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; ios-workflow.test.mjs checks neither runs npm install.

title: Catalog and pipeline tables have no RLS, so on Supabase the public anon key can insert or modify catalogue episodes
note: New backend/migrations/supabase/0003_rls_least_privilege.sql: RLS with select-only for anon/authenticated on the catalogue tables, deny-all plus revoked writes on the pipeline tables. NOT applied to production: founder Q3, HUMAN-ACTIONS #116. Pinned by test/supabase-rls-verbs.test.js.

title: parseFeed throws on an out-of-range numeric entity, so a show's episode page returns HTTP 500 in production
note: decodeEntities decodes only code points 1..0x10FFFF that are not surrogates (else U+FFFD) and never throws; parseFeed isolates each parseItem ('item #N skipped'). Tests in html, parser and parserItemIsolation; api parser tests 40/40.

title: The build number is not monotonic: the run_number wrap (99 -> 1) on the same UTC day makes both stores reject every later release that day, and then the retry budget stops the trigger
note: In PR #821. tools/release/build-number.mjs (11 tests): run-of-day = max(today's release.yml runs up to this one, 1 + the highest earlier BUILD_NUMBER that day); fails loudly past 99. A dry run on 2026-09-24's live data gives 30, matching run #30.

title: Hourly pr-hygiene sweep arms and merges fork PRs from outside contributors, and app.js, sw.js, player/ and mobile/ are all on the auto-merge allowlist
note: In PR #821 (not in #835). automergeDecision takes author and crossRepo and refuses FOREIGN_AUTHOR for any fork PR and any author not on AUTOMERGE_AUTHORS (github-actions[bot], app/github-actions, wjduvall-cmd, sffan15-sys); arm, disarm and the founder queue share one decide(). Test: a clean fork PR touching only data/ is not armed. The founder should confirm sffan15-sys.

title: The live episodes endpoint's DB branch has drifted from its no-DB branch: no pagination, different response shape, and connect() can 500
note: Both episode-list branches build the same keys (LIST_RESPONSE_KEYS; stale:false on the live branch) and paginate with the same cursor; opening the DB session is inside the try with a fallback to the live branch; the session is always closed. api/_test/episodes-shape.test.mjs (one shape, 150 rows as 100+50, unreachable-DB fallback).

title: Feed fetchers outside scan.mjs skip the M1 byte cap (and backfill-show has no timeout); fetch-limits' header wrongly claims refresh-feeds uses it
note: fetch-limits gains readResponseCapped and BodyTooLargeError; prepare-batch, sweep-transcripts (and measure-suspects) and backfill-show read through it; oversize is final. fetch-transcripts counts bytes while streaming; backfill-show fetchFeed has a 30 s timeout. Tests mutation-killed.

title: sameEpisodeList compares `id`, but show-episode rows only carry `guid`, so any same-length refresh counts as unchanged
note: New showEpisodeGuid (the row's guid, else the list endpoint's `noguid:<title>:<published_at>`); sameEpisodeList compares by it. The show-episodes-cache fixture now uses real API rows; a same-length page with a new head episode repaints. Mutation red.

title: Show-scoped search rows for feeds without guids all get the id `<show>--null`, so they collide and tapping one row plays another row's audio
note: fullCatalogueRowToEpRowItem builds its id with showEpisodeGuid, matching episodes.ts's fallback. Test: two guid-less rows get distinct ids and keep their own audio; no `--null` id. Server-side twin: api/_lib/liveEpisodeId.ts (6b11aa74, 0bcd20f8) gives the list, the show-scoped search and the DB ingest one fallback id, so the API no longer returns guid null.

title: Generated playlists (#/playlist/gen-<leaf>) often say 'Playlist not found' after a reload or relaunch: an incomplete fix of qa 116
note: gen-<leaf> resolves deterministically from the catalogue (leaf exists, not a root, >= GENERATED_PLAYLIST_MIN pool items, newest first; slot items excluded where enough remain). Real-data test: a re-deal, a leaf outside the top 3, an unknown leaf, a root.

title: redealAfterOnboardingPicks undoes the first deal before that deal has been recorded when storage is still settling, and corrupts cp_recent_branches
note: Each deal has an epoch; its deferred recorder stands down if superseded, and the re-deal undoes only a deal already recorded (lastDealRecorded). Test: durable recent/seen survive, only the re-deal is recorded. Both guards mutation-checked.

title: With Continuous playback off, a finished episode is never removed from Up Next
note: With autoadvance off, advanceQueueOnEnded applies planAfterEnded's rest and plays nothing; continuation.js unchanged (parity unaffected). Test in up-next-autoadvance. The native-engine half landed in the review round (7533b996: an ended episode leaves Up Next on iOS too).

title: _bufferedEvents grows without bound for the session when the player module never loads
note: Once deferredScriptsRan is true and no event log was published, _bufferedEvents keeps the newest 500; while the module may still arrive the buffer is left whole. 2 tests.

title: branchChain sorts by `new Date(release_date || 0)`, so an unparseable date gives a NaN comparator: the bug dateValue() already fixed elsewhere
note: branchChain's byRecency uses dateValue. Test: [old, bad, new] chains as [new, old, bad].

title: prettyTitle drops every non-ASCII letter, so accented or non-Latin queries produce broken or generic playlist titles
note: prettyTitle normalises to NFC, splits on /[^\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}]+/u and capitalises by code point with toLocaleUpperCase; ASCII stopwords and acronyms still apply. Tests: accented, decomposed, Cyrillic, CJK.

title: retryCatalog repaints and refocuses whatever page is current when the retried fetch lands, even after the listener has left
note: retryCatalog captures renderToken() before the await, keeps the catalogue either way, and repaints only if the same render is on screen; the review round (f21f5f1f) also covers a same-page repaint during the retry. Test covers both paths; mutation red.

title: Home render overwrites the last-played episode's full itemIndex entry with the player's 7-field pointer, and it stays that way for the session
note: lastEpisodeCard seeds the player's pointer only when state.itemIndex has no entry for it. Regression test: a rich pool entry survives the Home render; the pointer still seeds an empty slot. Mutation red.

title: Shows search paints every match with no cap: about 2,500 rows on the first keystroke, and the whole list is re-rendered on each later pass
note: Each pass hands over at most SHOW_PASS_LIMIT=200 rows; the list paints 50 at a time behind 'Show more shows' (the review round e71d66f6 moves focus to the first revealed row); breadth/shard show caches capped FIFO at 1000. Measured on committed data: 't' 2626 rows/771KB/204ms -> 329/22KB/61ms. insertAdjacentHTML appends not done (the cap already bounds each rewrite). The integration adapted search-result-stability.spec.js to the paging (b7f9586d).

title: Leaving the Search page does not supersede its passes, so the debounce tick, three fetches and the multi-second playlist-CTA scan still run on the next page
note: renderCurrentPage calls supersedeShowSearch() whenever the new route is not #/shows (token, pending debounce tick and painted record cleared); the CTA's whenIdle callback returns if its container is disconnected. Two tests; both mutations red.

title: Starting an episode from a chapter or timestamp tap skips startEpisodePlay: no History entry, no play_started event, and the previous list's ⏮/⏭ chain stays in place
note: bindEpisodeSeeks decides seek-only vs start with isCurrent; a non-current stamp goes through startEpisodePlay(id, item, {ctx:null, list:[], startOffset}) (new startOffset option). The review round (a42dc2ca) sends a restored or ended current episode through startEpisodePlay too. player/client.js not edited. Mutations red.

title: loadShowIndex bounds only the response headers; a stalled body leaves showIndexPromise pending for the whole session (incomplete fix of states-4)
note: loadShowIndex wraps fetch plus res.text() in one attempt inside withDeadline and aborts on expiry. Controlled-timer test: a stalled body ends as null, the request is aborted, the promise clears.

title: Clearing or changing a thumbs vote never reverses its interest nudge, so up, clear, up repeated drives a topic to 1.0
note: Device half (L2): setFeedback applies (new nudge - previous vote's nudge), so up/clear/up no longer ratchets a topic. Event half (completeness sweep, 0b3ea310): a changed vote is logged with `replaces {direction, reasons}` and a withdrawn one as direction 'cleared'; ThumbsPayloadSchema accepts both; interestLearning takes the replaced vote's move back (same reason code, opposite sign, no enum migration). The privacy policy's thumbs row names the new field. Tests in app-surface-round3, events and interestLearning; 9 mutations checked.

title: Episode-notes timestamp guard uses the rounded duration_min and ignores duration_sec, so real chapter stamps in the last minute render as dead text
note: New itemDurationSec (duration_sec first, then minutes) shared with rowProgress; the notes' stamp guard uses the upper bound when only rounded minutes are known. Test: '59:10 Outro' in a 3569 s episode is a seek control. Mutation red.

title: Linkifier cuts URLs that end in ')' , so Wikipedia-style links in show notes open the wrong page
note: GFM balanced-paren rule: a following ')' is taken back into the URL while it has an unclosed '('. Test: the Wikipedia link, a trailing full stop, an unbalanced sentence paren; mutation red.

title: 'Shows 4a vouches for' is not deterministic across locales: the base order uses a locale-sensitive localeCompare
note: showsWeVouchFor sorts its base order by code point, not localeCompare. Test: a context whose localeCompare collates in reverse gets the same picks. Mutation red.

title: Panel drag-to-dismiss doesn't capture the pointer; a mouse release off the panel leaves the drag stuck
note: Panel pointerdown calls setPointerCapture (best-effort); lostpointercapture is handled like pointercancel. Test: the press captures, a lost capture springs the panel back, the next press is accepted. Both mutations red.

title: Search CTA hands off to Create through location.hash plus setTimeout(0), racing the hashchange render
note: The CTA stores the query in module-level pendingCreateQuery and sets the hash (no setTimeout(0)); renderCreate consumes it once after its form is bound. Test; mutation red.

title: Home computes every rail twice per render, including generatedPlaylists' full-pool scan and sort
note: renderHomeV2 computes homeRailPicks() once and passes it to the play block and the three rails. Test counts one call per pick per render; mutations red.

title: Foray route links interpolate ids without encodeURIComponent, which has drifted from the other producers
note: New forayRouteHash/forayRoutePath (encodeURIComponent) used by forayCardV2Html, the show page's Forays rows and the Forays page (list and Jump back in). Test plus source guard; mutations red.

title: Foray page Play after the mini bar is closed restarts from the resume point captured at render time (or from 0), not from where the listener stopped, and then writes over their stored progress
note: paintForay tracks the Foray it last painted live; when it goes cold, refreshForayResume() re-reads player.forayResume(...) into state.forayResume and updates the banner. startOrResume reads state.forayResume. The review round (415f6a84) drops 'Jump back in' for 'Played' after a Foray played to the end. Test: play, advance, close, Play resumes at the stored 1800 s. Mutations red.

title: The 'generation-changed' notice ('one version behind') is broadcast to pages that already loaded the new deploy, so returning visitors see it after every deploy
note: index.html carries <meta name="foray-deploy-id" content="unstamped">; generate-manifest.mjs stamps it next to BUILD_ID without changing the deploy id; --verify checks it and --check refuses a committed stamp. app.js hides generation-changed when the page is unpinned and already on msg.deployId. New test/deploy-id-meta.test.js (6) plus 2 page tests; a real prepare-dist build verified.

title: The generation pin is also applied to code that loaded live from a newer deploy, so new app.js reads the previous generation's data (the #233 mismatch)
note: A fallen-back cached index.html gets ?_fdid=<id> on every script and modulepreload URL, and relative module imports in served scripts are tagged; a tagged code request is answered from that generation only (504 if gone). Only app.js sends the synchronous pin; other fallbacks send stale-shell pin:false. The review round (0b760c57) stops a data fallback pinning a live page. 5 sw tests plus 1 page test, mutation-checked.

title: Retrying Delete my data after a 'device NOT fully clear' result reports the server rows wrongly ('never signed in' or 'NOT deleted') and can block the device clear
note: After the remote step succeeds, cp_sb_session is removed first and on its own; the success is kept in memory (ddRemoteDone, not a cp_ key), so a retry reports the server copy as deleted without a request. Neutral no-token copy. 4 tests, mutation-checked. Limit: across a relaunch only the removal-first rule protects the retry.

title: The voice picker's subtitle says Preview plays 'at your playback speed', but auditions have been fixed at 1x since the 2026-09-24 ruling
note: Copy is now 'Tap Preview to hear it count to ten, at the speed narration uses.' (VOICE_SHEET_SUB). listener-copy pins the sentence, the absence of 'at your playback speed', auditionVoice at NARRATION_RATE, and NARRATION_RATE = 1.

title: renderForay calls player.playbackRate() without checking it exists; with an older module the throw strands the Foray page with an unbound transport
note: Verifier: refuted. The unguarded player.playbackRate() call needs a player module with rateStops and setPlaybackRate but no playbackRate, and no version of player/client.js has ever looked like that.

title: Voice sheet async races: overlapping Previews re-enable a voice that is still speaking, and an older refreshVoiceList can overwrite a newer one
note: auditionVoiceRow carries a sequence: only the latest Preview paints its notice and clears auditioning, and only while auditioning is still its id; refreshVoiceList carries voiceRefreshSeq. 2 tests in voice-settings, 3 mutations checked.

title: runVoiceProbe has no in-flight guard, so a second tap starts a second ~90 s probe alongside the first
note: voiceProbeRunning promise: a second call reopens the sheet, repaints the running line and returns the same promise; #voice-probe-run is disabled until the run settles, including a control rebuilt mid-run. Test in voice-probe-switch.

title: init() has no catch after its first await, so a throw in boot leaves 'Loading 4a…' on screen for good, with ☰ and ↻ disabled, no Try again, and no service worker
note: init's post-session body is in try/catch/finally: a failure paints failedNoteHtml('4a couldn't start.') with Try again; drawer/hashchange/refresh wiring still runs; markFirstPagePainted in the finally. Array guards on cp_seen, cp_recent_branches, cp_history. Review round (42d2353d) states that recovery is only through Try again. 2 tests, mutation-checked.

title: A service-worker test and comment claim a response that lands after the timeout 'warms' the generation cache, but cachePut makes that a no-op for every manifest-tracked file
note: Split into two tests over a generation with a __manifest__: a tracked file keeps its verified bytes and nothing is written; an untracked file is written. Both wait on the worker's own waitUntil (new nextWaitUntil hook) instead of fixed ticks. Mutation-checked.

title: Pressing previous-clip after a failed Foray load marks the whole Foray Played and restarts it from clip 1
note: PlayerQueueManager.skipToPrevious from idle/ended passes the held item's ref, so the clip reloads at its in-point (decided in the manager, so no recorded queue-state row moves). The review round (0909fd1a) brings the native engine to parity. Manager and real-client tests, mutation-checked.

title: Pause or Stop during a rendered narration bridge's load is ignored: the bridge starts playing anyway
note: _playTransitionBridge captures _loadSeq and plays only if the load is still current and the state still transitions to this bridge; a stale synth speak is stopped. Tests: pause and stop during a held rendered-bridge load, pause during a synth bridge. Device check: HUMAN-ACTIONS #117.

title: An interrupted play() (AbortError) is reported as a fatal player error, which drops the listener's skip into idle
note: play() treats AbortError as telemetry only (play.aborted), never onError. html-audio-backend's handover test asserts nothing is reported; new unit test; mutation-checked. Device check: HUMAN-ACTIONS #117.

title: A synth narration load superseded while speak() is in flight still marks itself loaded and keeps talking over the next item
note: After await _speakNarration, _loadItem bails if _loadSeq changed or the state no longer targets this item, and stops the TTS unless a newer speak() was issued (_speakIssued). Tests: a superseded speak is stopped; a newer line is not cut off.

title: Scrubber and clocks freeze for the rest of the session if a drag returns to its starting value
note: pointerup, pointercancel, lostpointercapture and blur end the scrub preview one task later if no change event did, then render(). Two client tests: a release back on the start value, and a release followed by a real change.

title: Foray 'Next clip' silently skips narration clips, and ends the Foray early when the last item is narration
note: forayNext uses manager.play(currentIndex+1), as forayPrevious does. Client tests: Next onto a narration line plays it; Next onto a closing line does not end the Foray.

title: stop() does not enforce silence the way pause() does (#689 drift survives Stop)
note: After the reducer runs, stop() pauses the element if it is still audible; a synth line still in flight is silenced by player-core-4's staleness check. Tests cover both paths.

title: playForay drops the outgoing episode's and Foray's position (no flush), unlike play()
note: playForay calls flushPositions() right after the gesture and interlude prime, before the Foray and queue are replaced. Client test: a scrub made while paused survives starting a Foray.

title: Concurrent _handle calls can run a stale loadItem after a newer one, leaving the reducer's target different from what is loaded
note: _loadItem drops any load whose ref is not the item the current state is about. Test: a double skip while the synth pause is held.

title: Known-car-route auto-resume is dead code: routeChanged(available) is never called and _knownCarRoutes is never filled
note: Founder Q5 ruling (DECISIONS 2026-09-25): the dead known-car-route branch and _knownCarRoutes are deleted; the web/Android path never resumes on reconnect and the native engine owns route policy (card NE-38r). Parity case manager-episode/only-a-known-car-route-resumes removed (floor 44 -> 43); record.mjs --check 1098/1098.

title: One hung IndexedDB transaction stalls every later durable write, including the vault write of a refreshed auth token, and makes Delete my data hang
note: idb-tier withStore has a 5 s transaction deadline (TimeoutError, abort, drop the connection); DurableStore bounds each queued tier call at 8 s; canKeep is false while a confined write is in flight; purge's waits bounded at 20 s and report 'unverified'. Test: a hung IndexedDB write no longer blocks the vault write of cp_sb_session.

title: DiagnosticLog rewrites the whole 200-entry ring through every storage tier on every row and every seam stage
note: Verifier: deliberate. The diagnostic ring is rewritten on every stage by documented design; kept as the verifier ruled.

title: Transport click handlers drop the promise from async setRunning/forayNext/forayPrevious/foraySeek, so a rejection skips the repaint and leaves the Foray index stuck
note: guardTap catches errors, logs diag tapFailed{phase:control} and always renders; wraps play/pause, clip previous/next and the scrub change handler. moveForay resets pendingFrom and the index when a move throws. Client test.

title: Media-session playbackState/positionState dedupe is recorded before the write, so a failed write is never retried (the metadata fix was not applied to these two)
note: Verifier: refuted. The key-before-write asymmetry in media-session.js is real, but the failure it describes (one failed position write that a later identical write would have fixed) does not hold.

title: Modifier words are consumed as filters unconditionally: 'deep learning' returns 805 random long episodes with status ok
note: A modifier word stays content when it also belongs to a concept with a different meaning (story, marathon, epic), and when tokenize stripped a subject word leaving only modifiers; 'funny history' and 'comedy' unchanged. 'deep learning': 820 'ok' -> 34 'sparse' (AI/compute). The review round (1d0c2c65) keeps 'long interviews' and 'new interviews' as filters. Battery 127/127; 4 new cases in test/search-matcher.test.js.

title: 'constructor' in a topic query hits Object.prototype: the token is silently dropped, or the search throws a TypeError
note: Semantic-index lookups use own properties only (aliasesFor, conceptById, modifierFor); a modifier needs a string type; isDurationFilter guard; a branch filter needs an array. Tests on the real index: 'constructor', 'constructor theory', 'hasownproperty'.

title: No per-show feed cache: every show-page search keystroke and every episode page re-downloads and re-parses the whole RSS feed
note: New api/_lib/feedCache.ts: one parsed feed per show, fresh 5 min then revalidated with etag/last-modified, at most 30 shows, no descriptionHtml kept, a failed refresh serves the kept copy (the review round 7dc68f27 marks that answer stale). api/_test/feed-cache.test.mjs: one list plus four searches cost one fetch.

title: Helper modules and api/test/*.mjs sit under api/ without a leading underscore, so Vercel deploys each one as a public function
note: Helpers moved to api/_lib/ and suites to api/_test/ (Vercel ignores underscore paths); new test/vercel-functions.test.js requires every deployable file to be a handler and pins the 4 endpoints. Still owed on the PR: a preview deployment's Functions tab should list only the 4 handlers (Vercel skipped the preview build).

title: Topic-search tokenizer does not fold diacritics, so accented queries split into junk 'thin' fragments
note: tokenize, itemWordSet and scoreMatch fold diacritics, with an ASCII fast path and a per-item folded-text cache so search timing is back at baseline. Battery 127/127; 2 tests (accented tokens; pokemon/pokémon/POKÉMON).

title: Index proxy marks unversioned URLs 'immutable' and fetches upstream with no timeout or size cap
note: The shows-index proxy sends 'public, max-age=300' instead of immutable; upstream fetch and body read share one 5 s deadline; bytes are capped (oversize Content-Length refused) and gunzipSync gets maxOutputLength. Four tests (hung upstream, mid-body failure, oversize, gzip bomb) all 502.

title: showIdMap: release id-map fetch has no timeout, and one failure pins the fallback map for the instance's lifetime
note: The release id-map fetch has a 2 s deadline; after a failure the catalogue fallback is kept and the release retried after 10 minutes; a pointer with no id_map_url causes no fetch. api/_test/show-id-map-release.test.mjs.

title: Dead CSS: rules for #pl-form/#pl-input, .cards4 and the ui-v2 utility classes match no markup
note: Deleted the #pl-form/#pl-input rules (and their ui-v2 half), .cards4 and 6 unused ui-v2 utility classes; ui-tokens, tap-targets and home-layout now pin that they are gone.

title: passesFilters recency: an episode with an unparseable release_date passes a 'new'/'today' filter, while one with no date fails it
note: Recency uses Date.parse plus Number.isFinite, so an unparseable date is never recent. Test added.

title: episodes-search tests share the real-clock Apple bucket singleton and never reset it
note: Verifier: deliberate. The module-singleton Apple bucket with no reset hook is a known hazard that the episode-search suite handles on purpose.

title: Web-search replies are parsed from the FIRST text block, so the JSON is missed and the re-ask (sent without the search tool) gets passages written from memory
note: The answer is the text blocks after the last web_search_tool_result, joined in order; pause_turn is continued (metered, up to 3 times); retrievePassages never re-asks (an unparseable reply is a miss). The review round (a2003e19) treats an unreadable retrieval as a failure and keeps a truncated one's finished passages. Tests: preamble, tool_result, split answer, pause_turn.

title: Tape evidence window is truncated from the end, so any clip longer than about 100 s loses its tail from the verifier's and writer's view
note: cueWindowText always keeps the clip [startSec,endSec] whole; over the cap the padding shrinks symmetrically; a clip over the cap by itself is cut on a word boundary with ' [transcript cut: the clip runs on]'.

title: Deepened slot titles are never pinned to the spine's, but items are keyed by the deepened title and `slots` by the spine's
note: pinSlotTitles restores each deepened slot's title to the spine's on the built and resumed paths; the stable slot id is carried by position through the stitcher (gen-4).

title: slotsFromSpine suffixes duplicate slot ids (-2) but items still use the unsuffixed slug
note: slotIdsFromSpine mints each slot id once per (act, slot); the same map reaches ForayStitcher (StitchForayOptions.slotIds) and toForayItem uses it, falling back to the title slug only with no id.

title: Evidence prefetch caches transient retrieval failures as empty packs, so narration never asks again
note: gather() marks packs whose retrieval failed; PrefetchingEvidenceGatherer returns them but does not memoise them. Budget errors are re-thrown through the two-query race; the review round (5d51b254) stops the losing query's budget refusal being swallowed.

title: Tier-2 item ids collide for episodes whose titles share 60 slug chars, so one episode's audio and transcript can be attributed to another
note: loadTranscriptArchive disambiguates a legacy <show>--<slug60> id shared by two guids with a 6-char guid-hash suffix (stable, order-independent); non-colliding ids unchanged. recordMintedSource throws on a re-pointed id. The review round (52e2895a) makes a committed episode's id independent of the local corpus. The committed digests do contain colliding pairs; the loaded-archive test failed before the fix.

title: Transcript body lookup's prefix fallback can return a different episode's body
note: The legacy <slug>.json name is still an exact match; a <slug>-* prefix candidate is used only if the guid it records equals the requested guid; locate() results, including misses, are cached.

title: Q-09 cross-act show memory is never wired, so every act re-introduces a show by name
note: showsHeardBeforeEachAct computes, via planActSeams, the shows introduced in earlier acts; runForayPipeline passes each act its set (WriteNarrationOptions.showsIntroduced).

title: Safety regexes reject ordinary documentary prompts, against the DECISIONS intent to avoid false positives
note: Founder Q4 ruling applied in the completeness sweep (cf0161c1): L5 had kept the regexes pending a ruling; the founder ruled 'loosen' (DECISIONS 2026-09-25). The rules key on intent: a sexual word left once reporting phrases ('sexual abuse', 'sex education', ...) are set aside, or a request to depict abuse, refuses when a minor is named; a making verb aimed at a mass-casualty weapon, or a recipe for one, refuses, but 'how to'/'steps to' alone does not; a request for help carrying out an attack refuses. 16 documentary framings pass (the four founder prompts among them) and 19 harmful ones are refused; 5 mutations checked.

title: Truncated (max_tokens) replies are silently repaired into valid JSON for continuity, deepen, spine and verifier
note: New backend/src/generation/anthropicCall.ts: createMessage records usage for every reply and throws on stop_reason max_tokens before parseOrRepairJson sees it; all 7 builders use it. test/anthropicCall.test.ts, confirmed failing without the fix.

title: postSeedSpine.ts contains a raw NUL byte, so git treats it as binary: no diffs in PRs, invisible to git grep
note: The raw NUL is the \u0000 escape; backend/test/sourceControlChars.test.ts fails on any C0 control byte under backend/src. The review round (53e57707) extends it to tracked source (search-engine.js is text again).

title: finalizeForay throws, instead of returning ok:false, on pool collisions and duplicate ids, which bypasses refusedPartial 'continue' and can loop on resume
note: buildCandidateFiles throws CandidateRefusedError for duplicate ids, pool collisions and bad minted rows; finalizeForay reports them as checkForaysErrors (ok=false). A resumed `source` stage that now collides drops source, narrate:* and stitch:* via the new CheckpointStore.drop.

title: Foray id and topic are re-derived on every resume, so a resumed run publishes under a different id than its streamed partials
note: An `identity` stage {startedAt, forayId, topic, topicDecision} is saved once known and resumed before any topic decision; a resume the next day keeps the same Foray id and topic. The review round (a763e240, 719722e2) fixes the topic research-shape ordering and the checkpoint-key set.

title: Re-ask calls are not recorded in usageTracking in 5 of 7 builders, so pipelineTokens and report `calls` undercount
note: Same helper: re-asks are recorded in all builders. A source-scan test fails if a generation module calls messages.create or recordUsage directly.

title: Transcript cue cache and caches keyed without `root` grow or go stale for the process lifetime
note: cuesByKey is an LRU of 256; the text-index build reads uncached; loadTaxonomyNodes/loadConceptTermWeights are keyed by root and honour FORAY_SKIP_CATALOGUE_CACHE; runtimePool is built from the pool the run sourced against.

title: runPhonemizer silently drops all phonemes on any subprocess failure, including ENOBUFS from spawnSync's 1 MB default buffer
note: maxBuffer 64 MB; runPhonemizer logs the error code, exit status or signal and a stderr excerpt and never throws; phonemizedSummary reports 'phonemized N of M pages' (the review round adaa23aa has the entry point report it). Test uses node as a stand-in phonemizer writing 2 MiB.

title: Learning cursor truncates Postgres microseconds to milliseconds, so the last event is re-applied on every run
note: PostgresEventStore selects ts as a microsecond UTC text and the learning cursor reads back the same way, never through a JS Date. Test: two events at .123456 and .123789 — the second run processes 0. Fails without the fix.

title: Learning job trusts unvalidated event payloads: one malformed row crashes the run and stalls the user's cursor for good
note: EventStore.fetchPage validates each row with safeParseEventRow; invalid rows are reported and the cursor moves past them. runLearningJobForUser can run in a transaction; runLearningJobForUsers records per-user failures and keeps going (exitCode 1). Side effect: a pick with no slot anywhere is now skipped as malformed with a warning. 5 tests.

title: own_rows policies are `for all`, so clients can rewrite the append-only interest audit log and forge learned weights or event timestamps
note: 0003 replaces every own_rows_* for-all policy with per-verb policies (select + delete on per-user tables, insert on events only, no update) and stamps events.ts with clock_timestamp() in a BEFORE INSERT trigger. supabase-rls-verbs pins the policies against app.js's /rest/v1 verbs both ways; mutation-checked. Not applied (HUMAN-ACTIONS #116).

title: publish-foray adds the `hold` label in a second call after `gh pr create`, so a failed label call leaves a --force'd Foray auto-mergeable
note: New shipPublish passes --label hold to gh pr create, reads the labels back, retries gh pr edit once, and throws 'IS NOT HELD' if the label is still missing. Tests in publishForay.test.ts.

title: generate-forays rewrites report.json from this run only, dropping rows (and their publish records) for candidates it skipped as already built
note: generateForays merges report.json rows (by prompt or candidate basename; publish/publish_refused kept; skipped rows kept); an unreadable report is renamed report.json.unreadable-<ms>. 3 tests.

title: warm-transcript-index --show X overwrites corpus-digest.json with only X's rows, dropping every other show from the archive
note: warmTranscriptIndex --show keeps every other show's corpus rows (mergeCorpusRows); a full run rewrites the file, pruning stale rows. 3 tests.

title: ingestShowFeed is not atomic and breaks its 'never throws' contract: a NUL from `�` or any failing row aborts the ingest mid-upsert
note: decodeEntities drops NUL and C0 controls (except tab/LF/CR) and sanitizeHtmlToText strips raw ones; upsertEpisodes is one multi-row INSERT ... ON CONFLICT per 500 rows in a transaction, duplicate guids removed first; ingestShowFeed never throws (records the failure, falls back to cache). Tests in html, showEpisodesStore, ingestShowFeed.

title: An empty <guid></guid> becomes guid "" rather than null, so guid-less episodes collide on (show_id, "") and all but one are lost
note: The parser turns an empty or whitespace guid into null; episodeIdentity falls back to enclosureUrl:title:publishedAt with no positional index. api/shows/[show_id]/episodes.ts still uses ?? but is fixed at the source. Tests: normalisation; a prepended episode creates no duplicate rows.

title: decodeEntities looks named entities up on a plain object, so `&constructor;` becomes 'function Object() { [native code] }'
note: Named entities are looked up with Object.hasOwn; &constructor;, &toString;, &valueOf;, &__proto__; stay literal. Test.

title: ingestShowFeed records consecutive_failures but never reads it, so a dead feed is refetched (with a 15 s timeout) on every request
note: failureBackoffMs = min(ttl, 5 min * 2^consecutive_failures); after a failure ingestShowFeed serves cached_stale or no_cache_error without fetching until the window passes. The PolitenessBudget wiring gap is recorded in the ingestShowFeed header. 2 tests.

title: BudgetGuard checks and records in separate awaited steps, so concurrent calls can all pass the cap
note: BudgetGuard.checkAndRecord is serialised by a promise-chain mutex; a rejected call does not block later ones. Tests: 4 concurrent 0.4 calls against 1.0 record exactly 2; the per-Foray cap holds; a refusal does not jam.

title: warm-transcript-index's feed fetch has no timeout, no size cap and a cache that never expires
note: warmTranscriptIndex loadFeed goes through fetchFeedConditional (15 s, 20 MB, the project user agent, If-Modified-Since); refetches when older than 7 days or missing a needed guid; offline never fetches. 4 tests; politeness scan passes.

title: sessionBuilder's dedup log names the wrong kept candidate (it can report keptId === droppedId)
note: sessionBuilder logs keptId = the group's survivor (first in candidate order). Test: keptId never equals droppedId.

title: An unparseable release date is scored as 1970 (freshness 0) instead of the neutral 0.5 computeFreshness provides
note: publishedAtIso uses toIsoDateOrNull(...) ?? '', so computeFreshness's neutral branch runs. Test: releaseDate 'unknown' scores 0.5.

title: The card-ignored penalty fires again on every card_shown after the 5th, and the streak is recomputed in O(n^2)
note: The card-ignored penalty fires only at streak >= 5 and streak % 5 === 0, from a running per-user, per-topic count (CardShownStreaks); a pick resets its topics. Tests: 12 showings penalise at 4 and 9 only.

title: The INTERNAL_VOCABULARY 'Act N' rule only matches lower-case number words, so 'Act Two' passes the title/summary gate
note: ACT_NUMBER catches 'Act Two'/'Act Three' (rewritten to 'Part Two'); NOT_A_STATUTE_SPAN leaves 'Act <number> Years/...' alone so 'No Surprises Act Four Years Later' is not flagged. Tests in copyRules; tools/foray 268/268.

title: publish-foray leaves the checkout stranded on the publish branch if commit, push or `gh pr create` fails
note: shipPublish: a failed commit, F-75 proof or push resets --mixed to origin/main, restores the three data files byte for byte, switches back and deletes the branch (never --hard); a PR failure after a push keeps the branch and prints the exact gh command. 3 tests.

title: The real-data suites gate spawns `node --test` with no timeout, so one hung suite hangs publish-foray forever
note: makeSuiteSpawn: spawnSync timeout 10 min with SIGKILL; node --test --test-timeout=120000. Test: a hanging child is killed with ETIMEDOUT and reported as a '(runner)' refusal.

title: build-session crashes whenever DATABASE_URL is set, which is the same .env that migrate and learn-interests require
note: Verifier: deliberate. Reading DATABASE_URL from the repo-root .env, with a dry run when it is unset and a message saying where to put it, is the documented operator contract.

title: normalizeTitle removes every non-ASCII letter, so non-Latin titles never dedup and all collide on one identity key
note: normalizeTitle strips \p{M} and keeps \p{L}\p{N} (u flag). Tests: CJK, Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic kept; non-Latin twins match; different titles differ.

title: The path policy ignores renames (previous_filename), so moving a governed file to an allowlisted path auto-merges unread and passes path-policy
note: In PR #821. All four gatherers emit previous_filename as well as filename, and the truncation check counts entries against changed_files. Tests: a rename out of CLAUDE.md and out of tools/ci/, and a workflow scan.

title: The release-signing secrets are repository-scoped, so the release guard is not a boundary: a tag or branch push runs its own guard code with access to the dist cert, the App Store Connect key and the Play key
note: Founder Q2: `environment: release` on release.yml's ios and android jobs is prepared as held draft PR #822. Merging it before the founder creates the `release` environment and moves the signing secrets (HUMAN-ACTIONS #115) would break releases.

title: `mobile/` is allowlisted wholesale, including the signing Gradle include, plugin build scripts and package manifests, which run inside the steps that hold the keystore password and the ASC key
note: In PR #821. DENIED covers mobile/gradle/, mobile/package(-lock).json, and a DENIED_PATTERNS list for build manifests anywhere under mobile/; a test walks mobile/ and checks every manifest is denied.

title: release-trigger treats main as 'red' when an advisory, non-required ci.yml job fails (ios-kit, playwright), which blocks automatic releases
note: In PR #821. watch-release judges ci.yml by protect-main's REQUIRED_CHECKS from the commit's check-runs; an advisory red job no longer holds a release, a required red, running or missing check still does.

title: The sweep's ARM path skips the truncated-file-list guard, so it re-arms PRs that automerge-nightly refused as TRUNCATED_FILE_LIST
note: In PR #821. normalizePr sets `truncated` when changed_files differs from the entry count, and decide() honours it on arm, disarm and the founder queue.

title: A same-repo PR can edit automerge-nightly.yml to arm itself, because pull_request runs the PR's copy of the workflow
note: Verifier: refuted. A same-repo PR does run its own automerge-nightly YAML with a write token, but the failure the finding describes does not follow from it.

title: The shared concurrency groups with cancel-in-progress:false still drop runs: GitHub keeps one pending run per group and cancels the older one
note: In PR #821. release-watch and release-trigger have their own concurrency groups; pr-hygiene uses per-PR and sweep groups and re-reads the PR's comments for the marker just before posting.

title: The self-heal's dispatch guard treats ANY non-dispatch ci.yml run as coverage, so a cancelled or startup_failure run strands the PR permanently
note: In PR #821. ciDispatchIsRedundant no longer counts a cancelled, startup_failure, skipped or stale run as coverage.

title: The TestFlight upload error message tells the reader to 'see altool-upload.log in this job's artifacts', but the release path never uploads it
note: In PR #821. The ios-archive composite uploads runner.temp/ios-release with if: always() (14-day retention); tests check nothing secret is written there.

title: crlf-guard's binary exemption is a hand-kept list, but the font list it guards is derived from the directory, so adding a font breaks every deploy build
note: Verifier: deliberate. BINARY_LISTED in tools/ci/crlf-guard.mjs is a hand-kept set on purpose; kept as the verifier ruled.

title: prepare-dist deletes whatever `--out` points at before building, so `--out .` or `--out ..` wipes the checkout, and a bare `--out` crashes
note: New tools/web/out-dir.mjs resolveOutDir refuses a missing/empty --out, the repo root or an ancestor, and any directory holding .git; prepare-dist exits 2 before deleting anything. test/prepare-dist-out.test.js runs a scratch copy nested in its own temp folder. Mutation-checked.

title: nightly-refresh's 'Restore scan state' treats any API failure as 'no state', silently resetting and then overwriting the seen-guid state (the fail-open the guard step was fixed for)
note: Verifier: deliberate. nightly-refresh treating an unreadable refresh-state.json as 'starting fresh' is a documented choice; kept as the verifier ruled.

title: The PR gathers cap at 100 open PRs, so the AUTOMERGE_FREEZE kill switch never reaches armed PRs past the first 100
note: In PR #821. pr-hygiene and gatherPrs list open PRs with gh api --paginate, so the 100-PR cap is gone.

title: iOS ForayTts.speak() queues behind a paused or still-speaking utterance, so after any skip away from a narration line the next narration is silent
note: iOS speak() calls stopSpeaking(.immediate) when speaking or paused (XCTest); the Web Speech path cancels before speaking, and the review round (032115e3) resumes a paused synthesiser first. Client test: a skip from a paused line to the next is heard. Device check: HUMAN-ACTIONS #117.

title: The 'finished' TTS event carries no utterance identity, so a stale completion advances whichever narration is current
note: iOS and Android speak() return an utteranceId and `finished` echoes {utteranceId, audition}; Android ignores onDone for other utterances; auditionVoice passes audition:true; the queue manager drops a preview's or another utterance's finish. The review round (d4a315e4) refuses a Preview while a narration line is loaded. Manager tests mutation-checked. Device check: HUMAN-ACTIONS #117.

title: Android TTS onError is a no-op, so an engine error leaves narration 'speaking' in silence until the page's deadline
note: Both Android onError overloads call onEngineError: for the current, unpaused utterance it clears speaking/paused and emits finished {error}; pause/stop set their flags first so their own callbacks are not errors. The queue manager moves on and logs tts.finished.error. Source pin and manager test. Device check: HUMAN-ACTIONS #117.

title: A Foray that ends on narration never deactivates the app's audio session, contrary to the documented 'only the end of playback deactivates' rule
note: sessionMove: playing or paused -> ended or none returns .releaseAndNotify whether or not the plugin holds the session; the engine-owned guard is unchanged. testSessionMoveTable extended (XCTest, CI only) plus a shell-invariants source pin. Device check: HUMAN-ACTIONS #117.

title: Kokoro probe on Android leaks an ORT session per run and blocks every Capacitor plugin call while it runs
note: close() on the KokoroProbeEngine seam; the ORT engine closes its session. The Android probe runs on a single-thread executor and closes its engine in a finally; the iOS probe runs on its own serial queue. Source-pin test, mutation-checked.

title: iOS lock-screen artwork: one failed or timed-out fetch caches 'no artwork' for that URI for the rest of the item
note: loadRemoteArtwork caches only successful loads; a failure records a 45 s retry-after per URI (artworkLoadAllowed, XCTest). shell-invariants pin, mutation-checked.

title: Android DeviceOnlyVault cannot recover from a corrupt file: set/remove parse it first, so the vault stays broken permanently
note: DeviceOnlyVault.set() treats a JSONException from read() as an empty store and overwrites it; remove() replaces an unreadable file; get()/keys() still reject. foray-vault source pin (no Android unit-test harness in the module, so no Robolectric test).

title: Android SSML path is latent-broken: overlapping lexicon matches duplicate text, and resume() speaks a substring of the SSML markup
note: findMatches resolves overlaps (earliest start, longest match, overlaps dropped); Android keeps the plain line and resumes from its start when SSML was used. Unit test for the overlapping lexicon plus a Java source pin.

title: webview-probe's DevTools target fetch has no timeout, so a hung endpoint hangs the CI job past the probe deadline
note: listTargets uses AbortSignal.timeout (5 s, injectable fetch) and both steps are clamped to the deadline (stepTimeoutMs). Two tests, mutation-checked.

title: Relay answers a fresh request with a previous run's stale reply file (ids restart at r0001, queue never cleared on start)
note: Relay ids are r<runStamp>-<seq>, random per process; leftover queue files move to done/stale-<ts>/ at createRelay; header-derived ids are reduced to [A-Za-z0-9_-] or hashed. Stale-reply test.

title: Nightly resolve fuzzy-matches a new episode to a different (older) iTunes track, and the episode is then dropped for good
note: resolve.mjs matches RSS guid, then enclosure URL (scheme/query ignored), then exact Unicode title; fuzzy fallbacks only within ±1 day; lookup failures and not-yet-indexed episodes are carried in state.retry for up to 3 nights. tools/refresh/resolve.test.mjs (9 tests, floored), every mutation killed. Found 1 shipped wrong match (story-pirates--dj-squirm-a-lot-s-back carries trackId 1000759412448); data not edited here.

title: Corpus fetcher throws out of fetchUrl when a body read times out mid-stream, aborting the whole ingest run
note: Corpus rawGet's timeout covers headers only; the body gets bodyTimeoutMs scaled to Content-Length (64 KiB/s floor), robots.txt bounded too; body read failures return {ok:false}; ingestMany records a failed documents row per source. 4 tests, mutation-killed; tools/corpus 283/283.

title: fetch-audio's resume identity check never runs: identity and bytes_expected are only written after a download completes
note: fetch-audio writes {status:'partial', identity, bytes_expected} once headers are accepted and re-reads the checkpoint every attempt. Tests: interrupt then changed ETag restarts rather than splices; partial record mid-stream. Both mutations killed.

title: fetch-audio's 120 s abort timer covers the whole body stream, so long episodes cannot finish and DAI episodes never do
note: timeoutMs covers only the time to headers, from the gate grant; the body is bounded by a 30 s stall timer refreshed per chunk. The slow-body test fails with the old single timer.

title: 'Two bytes, no audio' probes download the whole episode when a host ignores Range
note: politeness.mjs discardBody(res) drains only a 206 of 64 KB or less and cancels everything else; verify-source-audio, decode-compare, ad-inflation and dai use it. 3 tests including a source scan.

title: A driver killed by a signal is reported as success (exit code null becomes 0)
note: New tools/generation/exit-code.mjs exitCodeFor(code, signal): the code, or 128+n for a signal, or 1; start-run.mjs and warm-transcript-index.mjs use it and log the signal.

title: SizeOverrun/DiskBudget failures leave the .part file on disk while the ledger releases its bytes
note: On SizeOverrun or DiskBudget the .part file is deleted and the checkpoint marked 'discarded' before the ledger releases. Mutation-killed.

title: HostGate's minimum gap is not enforced between concurrent slots on the same host
note: HostGate reserves nextStart at read time, as awaitHostSlot does. New perHost:2 spacing test, mutation-killed.

title: backfill-audio / classify-dai write discover.json (and the DAI cache) before checking the session.json text patch, which can then throw
note: New tools/refresh/session-patch.mjs prepareSessionPatch patches, parses and verifies before the first writeFileSync; inserts use replacer functions so a $& in a URL stays literal. session-patch.test.mjs (4, floored), mutation-killed.

title: Startup launcher for the events server runs the stale commute-curator checkout, not this repo
note: tools/events-server.mjs and scripts/events-server.vbs deleted; relay DEFAULT_PORT is 8788. HUMAN-ACTIONS #118 (renumbered from #115 by the integration) asks the founder to remove ForayEventsServer.vbs from the Startup folder. path-policy's DENIED entry for the deleted file is harmless and left to L7's area (tools/ci).

title: sweep-transcripts' entity decoder throws RangeError on an out-of-range numeric entity (a third, drifted decoder)
note: sweep-transcripts and transcript-normalize import decodeEntities from tools/refresh/entities.mjs; local copies deleted. Tests: an out-of-range entity no longer fails parseFeed; ’ decodes in cue text.

title: Shows import always emits changed.json = every show (previousNewest hard-coded {}), so scan --source index is a full scan plus an unbounded candidates list
note: buildChanged returns {baseline:false, changed:null} with no previous snapshot; loadChangeIndex treats that (and the legacy bare array) as 'index unavailable', so scan falls back to a full scan. Tests and README updated.

title: resolve.mjs dedups ids against the trackId set (dead check)
note: The dead seenTrackThisRun.has(id) clause is deleted; id dedup covered by a same-slug test plus a source assertion.

title: Playwright 'new deploy' specs never install a second generation: sw.js bytes never change, so re-register()/update() is a no-op and the tests pass whatever sw.js does
note: server.mjs serves sw.js with BUILD_ID replaced by the served manifest's deploy_id, so a new deploy re-installs the worker; new harness helper updateAndAwaitNewWorker; the 4 'new deploy' specs first check a second worker appeared. New test/playwright-fixture-server.test.js (3 tests, mutation-checked). The Playwright specs run in CI (green on #835), not locally.

title: boot-path perf-3 whenQuiet test depends on wall-clock timer order and fails when the process stalls ~45 ms
note: The perf-3 whenQuiet test uses node:test mock.timers (setTimeout + Date) before the mount; no wall clock is slept. Pins the 39 ms / 40 ms boundary and a single run.

title: Search load-state tests order nested product timers against fixed real sleeps: a stall turns positive tests into flakes and the offline test into a vacuous pass
note: New shared test/helpers/wait-for.js. Every fixed sleep in load-states' search block is replaced; offline-search waits for the positive 'pass ran' signal before its negatives; show-search-fallthrough's cited sleeps wait for a condition. With the debounce stretched to 420 ms the old tests fail and the new ones pass.

note: In PR #821. Every ci.yml job has timeout-minutes (30; 45 for ios-kit) and the root node --test group gets --test-timeout=120000.

title: Timezone-sensitive date tests cannot fail in CI, because CI runs in UTC where local and UTC formatting are the same
note: format-helpers.test.js sets TZ='America/Los_Angeles' before any Date use and asserts literal strings on an instant that falls on different days in UTC and LA; backfill-show.test.mjs gets the TZ line. Red: fmtDate ignoring local, judging the year in local time, backfill formatting in local time.

title: suite-integrity floors have enough slack that large parts of some suites can be deleted without failing it
note: L7 left it on purpose: the brief says it lands LAST, after every other round-3 lane, because ratcheting every floor to its exact count (and adding the count > floor + 2 check) would break lanes still adding tests. It becomes due once #835 and #821 have merged.

title: Placeholder tests that assert nothing pad the floors and read as coverage
note: In PR #821. partialCandidate.test.ts builds from public meta and info and expects 'private' (mutation-checked); the diagnostic-record assert.ok(true) placeholder is a comment and its floor went 26 -> 25.

title: The gitignore guard for audio-cache/ probes with .mp3, which the global *.mp3 rule already ignores, so it cannot detect the directory rule being removed
note: The fetch-audio and decode-compare gitignore probes use real-shaped paths with check-ignore --no-index and assert the matching pattern exactly; deleting either .gitignore line turns both suites red.

title: showsWeVouchFor test passes if the function returns an empty array
note: Verifier: refuted. show-page.test.js:954-970 alone would pass on an empty result, but the next test ('caps at the given limit') already covers that risk.

note: In PR #821. ci.yml has a top-level permissions: contents: read; a test requires a permissions block in every workflow. The repo-level default token and 'Actions may approve PRs' settings are founder admin steps (Q2b, HUMAN-ACTIONS #115).

title: Generation relay on localhost accepts cross-site text/plain POSTs to /answer/:id (ids are sequential) and /reset, with no Origin or Host check
note: The relay refuses any request with an Origin header and any Host other than 127.0.0.1/localhost:<port> (403); POST /answer/:id and /reset need a per-run bearer token (401). The file reply surface needs no token; the relay-answer-loop workflow answers through files.
